_doc: Fast page flipping (audit AUD-002): queued turns are merged, the last page is drawn once. Reading at a normal pace is unchanged (reader_basic).

reader.page_turns.why: every press turns exactly one page: none is lost while the UI is busy

reader.turns_coalesced.why: turns that queued up during a waveform were merged (only the last page was rendered)

ui.action_to_visible_ms.TEXT.max.why: bounded wait: the page is stable within 2.5 s of any press, however long the burst (about 2 s with merging; before it grew with the burst, 5-6 s here)

ui.action_to_first_change_ms.p95.why: the panel starts changing within 2 s of a press during the burst
